label: SF・幻想文学
description: 想像力で現実を書き換える——ヒューゴー賞、ネビュラ賞から世界のSF・幻想小説まで。

books.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
books.author: Kurt Vonnegut
books.authorJa: カート・ヴォネガット
books.descriptionJa: 第二次世界大戦のドレスデン爆撃を生き延びた男が、時空を飞び回りながらトラルファマドール星人にさらわれる——戦争の狂気をSFの皮をかぶせて描いた、笑えて泣ける反戦小説。すべての出来事のあとに「So it goes.」と繰り返される refrain が、深い諦念とともに胸に残る。
books.whyReadJa: 村上春樹のユーモア感覚と「異世界」感が好きなら間違いなく刺さる。ポストモダン文学の入り口としても最適。
books.selectionReasonJa: 戦争の狂気をSFで描いた、笑えて泣ける反戦小説。
books.descriptionEn: A survivor of the Dresden firebombing is abducted by aliens from Tralfamadore and travels freely through time and space, unstuck in a life that refuses chronology. A funny and heartbreaking antiwar novel that cloaks the madness of war in science fiction, it is built around the refrain So it goes, repeated after every death with a calm that is both resignation and protest. It remains Vonnegut's masterpiece.
books.whyReadEn: If you love Murakami Haruki's humor and sense of another world, this will hit you directly. Also ideal as a gateway to postmodern literature, and one of the most humane antiwar novels ever written. Short, strange, and unforgettable.

books.title: Cloud Atlas
books.author: David Mitchell
books.authorJa: デイヴィッド・ミッチェル
books.descriptionJa: 19世紀の太平洋航海記から、未来のクローン社会、文明崩壊後のハワイまで——6つの時代と場所をまたぐ物語が、マトリョーシカのように入れ子構造で展開する驚異の小説。ブッカー賞候補。村上春樹の世界観をさらに複雑にしたような構造美。読めば読むほど新たなつながりが見えてくる。
books.whyReadJa: 「小説にしかできないこと」を追求した野心作。映画化もされたが、この構造は小説でしか味わえない。村上春樹とヴォネガットの中間地点を行く快作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 6つの時代がマトリョーシカ構造でつながる、現代SF文学の野心作。
books.descriptionEn: From a nineteenth-century Pacific voyage to a future clone society and a post-collapse Hawaii, six stories across ages and places unfold in a nesting structure like matryoshka dolls, each contained within the next. A Booker-shortlisted marvel of construction, the novel shows how actions echo across centuries and how souls are connected across time. The structure is beautiful in the way a Murakami worldview made even more intricate would be, and every reading reveals new connections.
books.whyReadEn: An ambitious pursuit of what only novels can do, and the structural pleasure is unique to the book. It was filmed, but the film cannot capture the nesting architecture. A joyride midway between Murakami and Vonnegut, and one of the most rereadable books of its generation.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: N.K. Jemisin
books.authorJa: N・K・ジェミシン
books.descriptionJa: 大地震が日常の世界で、地震を操る能力を持つ「オロジェン」たちは差別と搾取の対象——SFファンタジーの枠組みで人種差別と環境破壊の寓話を描き、ヒューゴー賞を史上初の3年連続受賞した金字塔。SFというジャンルを根本から書き換えた現代の必読書。
books.whyReadJa: SFに偏見がある人にこそ読んでほしい。文学としても最高水準で、差別の構造、環境危機、母と子の物語が絡み合う。読み始めたら止まらない。
books.selectionReasonJa: ヒューゴー賞3年連続受賞の金字塔。SFとファンタジーの境界を破った。
books.descriptionEn: In a world where catastrophic earthquakes are everyday reality, the orogenes, who can control the shaking, are targets of discrimination, exploitation, and fear. Using the framework of science fantasy, Jemisin tells an allegory of racism, environmental destruction, and survival, and became the first author in history to win the Hugo Award three years in a row. A modern must-read that rewrote the genre from its foundations.
books.whyReadEn: Read it even if you have prejudices against science fiction. It is top-tier literature, weaving together the structures of discrimination, environmental crisis, and a mother-and-child story. Once you start, you will not stop, and the second and third volumes are just as strong.

books.title: Annihilation
books.author: Jeff VanderMeer
books.authorJa: ジェフ・ヴァンダミア
books.descriptionJa: 未知の環境災害で閉鎖された「エリアX」に、女性生物学者が調査隊として足を踏み入れる——そこで彼女が見たものは、自然と人間の境界を溶解させる、おぞましくも美しい光景だった。映画化もされたニューウィアードの傑作。SFとホラーと環境文学の境界を消し去る。
books.whyReadJa: 短くて強烈。読後感が他の本と違う——「理解できないもの」に触れるカタルシス。カフカとラヴクラフトとレイチェル・カーソンの融合。
books.selectionReasonJa: 未知の環境と人間を描く、ニューウィアードの傑作。
books.descriptionEn: A female biologist enters Area X, a coastal region sealed off after an unknown environmental catastrophe, and what she finds dissolves the boundary between nature and the human in a vision at once horrible and beautiful. A masterpiece of the new weird, filmed as Annihilation, it erases the borders between science fiction, horror, and environmental literature, and leaves the reader transformed.
books.whyReadEn: Short and intense. The aftertaste is unlike any other book: the catharsis of touching what cannot be understood. The result is a fusion of Kafka, Lovecraft, and Rachel Carson, and the first volume of a trilogy that only deepens. Read it in one sitting.

books.title: Stories of Your Life and Others
books.author: Ted Chiang
books.authorJa: テッド・チャン
books.descriptionJa: 映画『メッセージ』の原作「あなたの人生の物語」を含む、たった8編でSF史を塗り替えた短編集。言語学、物理学、宗教学、計算機科学をモチーフに、人間の認識の限界に挑む。一編ごとに世界の見え方が変わる知性の結晶。SFを読まない人にこそ読んでほしい。
books.whyReadJa: 短編集の最高傑作の一つ。文学的にも科学的にも極上で、思考実験がこれほどエモーショナルな体験になるのかと驚く。ボルヘス『伝奇集』好きに。
books.selectionReasonJa: 映画『メッセージ』の原作。短編SFの最高傑作の一つ。
books.titleEn: Stories of Your Life and Others
books.descriptionEn: A collection of just eight stories that rewrote the history of science fiction, including "Story of Your Life," the basis for the film Arrival. Drawing on linguistics, physics, religion, and computer science, Ted Chiang tests the limits of human perception, challenging how we see the world. Each story reshapes your sense of reality, making this a dazzling showcase of ideas and intellect. A book to read even—or especially—if you don't normally read science fiction.
books.whyReadEn: One of the finest story collections ever written—literary and scientific at once. You'll be amazed that thought experiments can be so emotionally powerful. A must for fans of Borges's Ficciones.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.authorJa: カズオ・イシグロ
books.descriptionJa: 病弱な少女の「人工友人（AF）」として購入されたクララ。太陽の力で人間を癒せるのではないかと信じる彼女の純粋な視点を通して、愛とは、意識とは、人間であることの意味とは何かが静かに問われる。ノーベル賞作家が長篇デビュー作以来44年ぶりにSF的装置を使った話題作。
books.whyReadJa: 日本人の感性を持つノーベル賞作家の最新作。村上春樹ファンにも響く「異質な語り手が人間を見つめる」視点。AI時代の愛を考える一冊としても。
books.selectionReasonJa: ノーベル賞作家が描く、AIと人間の愛。
books.descriptionEn: Klara is an Artificial Friend purchased to keep a sickly girl company. Through her innocent, loving eyes—she believes the sun can heal human beings—the novel quietly asks what love, consciousness, and being human truly mean. The Nobel laureate's first use of science-fictional machinery in four decades, since his debut novel, and one of his most talked-about works.
books.whyReadEn: The Nobel laureate's latest novel, written with a Japanese sensibility. His estranged narrator observing humanity will resonate with Murakami Haruki fans—and it's a profound meditation on love in the age of AI.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.authorJa: フランク・ハーバート
books.descriptionJa: 宇宙の覇権を握る「香料」が産出される砂の惑星アラキス。そこに追放された貴族アトレイデス家の若き当主ポールは、砂漠の民フレメンと出会い、救世主としての運命に引きずり込まれる。SF文学の最高傑作にして、生態学と宗教と権力を巡る壮大な叙事詩。
books.whyReadJa: SFを読むならまずこれ。映画化で再注目される、宇宙オペラの金字塔。世界観の深さが桁違い。
books.selectionReasonJa: SF文学の最高傑作。生態学と宗教と権力の壮大な叙事詩。
books.descriptionEn: Arrakis, a desert planet where the spice that controls the galaxy is harvested. Paul, young heir of the exiled House Atreides, is drawn into the fate of a messiah when he meets the desert people, the Fremen. Widely hailed as the greatest work of science fiction, it is a sweeping epic of ecology, religion, and power.
books.whyReadEn: If you read one science-fiction novel, make it this. A milestone of space opera, thrust back into the spotlight by the film adaptations—and its depth of world-building remains unrivaled.

books.title: Foundation
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.authorJa: アイザック・アシモフ
books.descriptionJa: 数学によって未来を予測する「心理歴史学」。銀河帝国の崩壊を予見したハリ・セルダンは、文明の暗黒時代を短縮するため「ファウンデーション」を創設する。人類史の縮図として読める、SF黄金時代を代表する名著。
books.whyReadJa: 「文明はどう崩壊し、どう再建されるか」を一つの仮説で描いた、構想力の怪物。ドラマ化でも再注目。
books.selectionReasonJa: 文明の崩壊と再建を描く、SF黄金時代を代表する名著。
books.descriptionEn: Psychohistory—a mathematics that predicts the future. Foreseeing the collapse of the Galactic Empire, Hari Seldon founds the Foundation to shorten the coming dark age of civilization. A masterpiece of the Golden Age of science fiction that reads as a miniature of human history, and one of the most influential books of its kind.
books.whyReadEn: A monster of pure imagination that lays out, in a single hypothesis, how civilizations collapse and rebuild. Back in the spotlight thanks to the TV adaptation—its sweeping timeline and big ideas have inspired generations of writers and scientists.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.author: William Gibson
books.authorJa: ウィリアム・ギブスン
books.descriptionJa: 「サイバースペース」という言葉を生んだ、サイバーパンクの金字塔。雇われハッカー「ケイス」が、謎の依頼で巨大AIの世界へ潜入する。1980年代に書かれたにもかかわらず、ネット社会の原型を予言していた。
books.whyReadJa: 今の私たちの生活を形作った「デジタル世界観」の起源。SF史を変えた一冊。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「サイバースペース」を生んだ、サイバーパンクの金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: The cornerstone of cyberpunk, and the novel that gave the world the word "cyberspace." Hired hacker Case is plunged into the realm of a vast, mysterious AI on an impossible job. Written in the 1980s, it uncannily anticipated the shape of our networked world—making it essential reading for anyone who lives online.
books.whyReadEn: The origin of the digital worldview that shapes our daily lives. One book that changed the course of science fiction—and predicted the internet before it existed.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.authorJa: アーシュラ・K・ル＝グウィン
books.descriptionJa: 性別を持たず、月に一度だけ性別が発生する惑星ゲセン。大使として派遣された地球人のジェンリーは、性の概念を超えた「人間」の可能性に直面する。SF作家協会賞・ヒューゴー賞を受賞。性と人を問い直すSFの最高峰。
books.whyReadJa: 「性別がなかったら、人間はどうなるか」を描いた、フェミニズムSFの先駆け。イシグロも愛読。
books.selectionReasonJa: 性別を持たない惑星を描く、ヒューゴー賞受賞のフェミニズムSF。
books.descriptionEn: On the planet Gethen, people have no fixed sex, experiencing it only a few days each month. Genly Ai, an envoy from Earth, must confront what "human" can mean beyond the categories of gender. Winner of the Hugo and Nebula Awards, this is a towering work of science fiction that re-examines sex, trust, and what it means to be human.
books.whyReadEn: A pioneering work of feminist science fiction that asks: if there were no gender, what would humans become? A favorite of Kazuo Ishiguro as well. A quiet, profound novel about love, loyalty, and difference.

books.title: The Dispossessed
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.authorJa: アーシュラ・K・ル＝グウィン
books.descriptionJa: 無政府主義の理想郷アナレスと、資本主義の惑星ウラス。数学者シェヴェクは、二つの世界の橋渡しとしてウラスに旅立つ。理想社会の現実と、自由の意味を問う、ル＝グウィンの最高傑作。ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞。
books.whyReadJa: 「理想の社会」をSFとして真剣に考えた、思想性の高い傑作。政治と社会に興味のある人に。
books.selectionReasonJa: 理想社会を真剣に考えた、ル＝グウィンの最高傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Two worlds face each other: Anarres, an anarchist utopia, and Urras, a capitalist planet. The physicist Shevek leaves his home for Urras to build a bridge between them. A probing examination of how ideals fare in reality and what freedom truly means, The Dispossessed is Le Guin's finest novel, winner of both the Hugo and Nebula Awards.
books.whyReadEn: A highly intellectual masterpiece that takes "the ideal society" seriously as science fiction. For readers interested in politics, society, and how we might live differently. It's also a gripping story of one man torn between two worlds.

books.title: Kindred
books.author: Octavia Butler
books.authorJa: オクティヴィア・バトラー
books.descriptionJa: 1976年、黒人女性編集者のダナは、突然19世紀の奴隷制時代のメリーランドに呼び寄せられる。時代を超えて祖先の白人少年を守るたび、彼女は「黒人であり女性である」ことの歴史的現実を身体で経験する。タイムトラベルSFの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「タイムトラベル」を人種問題に使った、SF史に残る最重要作。人種文学とSFの交点。
books.selectionReasonJa: タイムトラベルで奴隷制時代へ。人種と歴史を問うSF史の傑作。
books.descriptionEn: 1976. Dana, a Black woman and book editor, is suddenly pulled back to antebellum Maryland in the 19th century. Each time her white ancestor's life is threatened, she is summoned to save him—and in doing so, she experiences in her own body the brutal historical reality of being Black and a woman. A landmark of time-travel science fiction.
books.whyReadEn: One of the most important works in science-fiction history, using time travel to confront race. Sitting at the intersection of Black literature and SF, it is urgent and unforgettable.

books.title: Parable of the Sower
books.author: Octavia Butler
books.authorJa: オクティヴィア・バトラー
books.descriptionJa: 環境崩壊と格差で社会が瓦解した2024年のアメリカ。共感覚を持つ黒人少女ローレンは、新たな宗教「アースシード」を胸に、崩壊する世界を北へ歩く。現代の気候危機を予見した、ディストピアSFの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「神は変化である」——独自の宗教観を持つ、思想性の高いSF。バトラーの代表作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 環境崩壊後のアメリカを描く、バトラーの代表作。
books.descriptionEn: America, 2024: society is collapsing under environmental ruin and inequality. Lauren, a young Black woman with a gift for hyperempathy, sets out on foot toward the north, carrying a new religion she calls Earthseed in her heart. A dystopian masterpiece that eerily foresaw today's climate crisis—and Butler at her most urgent and visionary.
books.whyReadEn: "God is change." A deeply philosophical science-fiction novel built on a radical theology, and arguably Butler's defining work. Essential for readers of today—its warning about a fractured world has only grown more relevant.

books.title: Fahrenheit 451
books.author: Ray Bradbury
books.authorJa: レイ・ブラッドベリ
books.descriptionJa: 本を燃やすことが使命の「消防士」モンターグ。しかし彼は、本が燃やされる世界の空虚さに気づき始める。「華氏451度」は紙が発火する温度。検閲と無知を描いた、ディストピア文学の古典にして、読書の意味を問う作品。
books.whyReadJa: 「本を読まない社会」を描いた警告。SNS時代の私たちにも通じる、思考の自由を問う一冊。
books.selectionReasonJa: 本を燃やす社会を描く、検閲と思考の自由を問う古典。
books.descriptionEn: Montag is a fireman whose job is to burn books. But he begins to glimpse the emptiness of a world where books are destroyed—"451 degrees Fahrenheit" being the temperature at which paper ignites. A classic of dystopian literature about censorship and ignorance, and a passionate inquiry into why reading matters.
books.whyReadEn: A warning about a society that stops reading. In our age of social media, its questions about the freedom of thought speak directly to us today. Short, vivid, and unforgettable.

books.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
books.titleJa: アンドロイドは電気羊の夢を見るか?
books.author: Philip K. Dick
books.authorJa: フィリップ・K・ディック
books.descriptionJa: 核戦争後の地球。賞金稼ぎのリックは、逃亡アンドロイドを「退役」させるため、感情を検出するテストを駆使する。映画『ブレードランナー』の原作。人間と機械の境界、記憶と共感の意味を問う、SFの金字塔。
books.whyReadJa: 「人間らしさ」とは何か——AI時代の私たちが読むべき、先見の明を持つ一冊。
books.selectionReasonJa: 人間と機械の境界を問う、映画『ブレードランナー』の原作。
books.titleEn: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
books.descriptionEn: After a nuclear war has nearly emptied the Earth, bounty hunter Rick hunts down escaped androids, using an empathy test to expose them. The novel behind the film Blade Runner, it is a cornerstone of science fiction that asks where the line between human and machine lies—and what memory, empathy, and compassion really mean.
books.whyReadEn: What does it mean to be human? A prescient novel for our age of AI, asking questions that only grow more urgent. One of SF's essential texts.

books.title: Solaris
books.author: Stanisław Lem
books.authorJa: スタニスワフ・レム
books.descriptionJa: 知性を持った海に覆われた惑星ソラリス。研究員クリスが、かつて亡くした妻の「複製」と再会する。理解しえないものとの遭遇を描き、SFと哲学を融合させたレムの最高傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「宇宙人は理解できるか」——接触SFの最高峰。難解だが、そこに文学的な深みがある。
books.selectionReasonJa: 理解しえないものとの遭遇を描く、接触SFの最高峰。
books.descriptionEn: Solaris is a planet covered by a vast, intelligent ocean. When researcher Kris arrives, he is confronted with a duplicate of his dead wife, recreated by the alien sea. A meditation on the impossibility of truly understanding the other, Lem's masterpiece fuses science fiction with philosophy in a way no one else has.
books.whyReadEn: Can we ever understand an alien mind? The pinnacle of first-contact science fiction—difficult, but rich with literary depth and unsettling questions. A book that haunts you long after you finish it.

books.title: Пикник на обочине
books.author: Arkady Strugatsky
books.authorJa: アルカジイ・ストルガツキー
books.descriptionJa: 地球に来訪した何者かが残した「ゾーン」——危険な異界と化した地域。その中に残された文明の遺物を狙う「スタルカー」たちがいた。映画『ストーカー』の原作。人間の欲望と未知との遭遇を描く、ロシアSFの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: タルコフスキー映画の原作としても有名。ゾーンという比喩が、今の世界にも強く響く。
books.selectionReasonJa: 映画『ストーカー』の原作。ゾーンという比喩が現代に響くロシアSF。
books.descriptionEn: Aliens came and went, leaving behind the Zone—a region transformed into a deadly, otherworldly place. There, stalkers risk their lives to salvage relics of a civilization not our own. The basis for Tarkovsky's film Stalker, this Russian science-fiction classic probes human desire and our encounter with the unknown.
books.whyReadEn: Famous as the source of Tarkovsky's film. The Zone works as a metaphor that still resonates powerfully with today's world—a haunting fable of longing and danger. Short, strange, and unforgettable.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.titleJa: ゲド戦記 影との戦い
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.authorJa: アーシュラ・K・ル＝グウィン
books.descriptionJa: 島々の群れ「アースシー」。若き魔法使いゲドは、力を試すために死の影を呼び出してしまう。その影から逃れ、名前と死と向き合う物語。トールキン以後のファンタジー文学を最も深く変えた、ル＝グウィンの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「名前」と「死」をテーマにした、ファンタジーの最高傑作。宮﨑駿監督が映画化を試みた。
books.selectionReasonJa: 名前と死をめぐる、ファンタジーの最高傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Earthsea, an archipelago of islands. Young wizard Ged summons a shadow of death while testing his powers, then must flee from it—and ultimately confront his own name and mortality. The book that most deeply transformed fantasy literature after Tolkien, this is Le Guin at her best, a luminous story of pride, balance, and self-knowledge.
books.whyReadEn: A masterpiece of fantasy built on the themes of names and death. Hayao Miyazaki once tried to adapt it to film—proof of its quiet power. One of the most beautiful books ever written.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.authorJa: アンディ・ウィアー
books.descriptionJa: 火星に取り残された宇宙飛行士マーク・ワトニー。仲間からは死亡と思われ、食料は限られる。しかし彼は植物学者であり、全人類が持つ道具「科学」と「ユーモア」で生き延びようとする。科学で一歩ずつ問題を解決する、感動の生存譚。
books.whyReadJa: 「科学で世界を攻略する」面白さ。SF初心者にも読める、ポジティブで痛快な一冊。
books.selectionReasonJa: 科学で火星で生き延びる、ポジティブで痛快なSF。
books.descriptionEn: Astronaut Mark Watney is stranded alone on Mars, presumed dead by his crew, with limited supplies. Fortunately he is a botanist—and he intends to survive using the tools all of humanity possesses: science and humor. A gripping and uplifting survival story in which each problem is solved step by step, with logic and a laugh.
books.whyReadEn: The joy of conquering problems with science. Accessible even to SF beginners, and wonderfully positive and exhilarating—a book you'll devour in one sitting. Funny, smart, and full of hope.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.titleJa: プロジェクト・ヘイル・メアリー
books.author: Andy Weir
books.authorJa: アンディ・ウィアー
books.descriptionJa: 記憶を失ったまま、未知の宇宙船で目覚めた男グレース。地球は危機に瀕しており、彼はその解決のための「一人の希望」だった。科学、友情、そして地球を救うミッション。『火星の人』の著者による、最高に心温まるSF。
books.whyReadJa: 「科学の面白さ」と「友情」を同時に味わえる。全人類が楽しめる、近年のSFの最高傑作の一つ。
books.selectionReasonJa: 科学と友情を描く、近年のSFの最高傑作の一つ。
books.descriptionEn: Ryland Grace wakes up on an unknown spaceship with no memory of who he is. Earth is in peril, and he—somehow—is its one hope. What follows is a mission of science and friendship to save the world, told with warmth and wit by the author of The Martian. One of the most heartwarming science-fiction novels ever written.
books.whyReadEn: Science's excitement and true friendship in a single book. One of the best-loved science-fiction novels of recent years, and one nearly everyone can enjoy. Heartfelt, funny, and impossible to put down.

books.title: Station Eleven
books.titleJa: ステーション・イレブン
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.authorJa: エミリー・セント・ジョン・マンデル
books.descriptionJa: 新型インフルエンザで文明が崩壊した20年後。廃墟となった北米を、移動演劇一座が旅する。疫病前後の世界を描き、芸術と記憶、人間の営みの意味を問う。全米図書賞候補。ディストピア文学の新しい古典。
books.whyReadJa: 「パンデミック後の世界」を描いたことで再評価された傑作。文明が壊れても残るものは何か。
books.selectionReasonJa: パンデミック後の世界を描く、ディストピア文学の新しい古典。
books.descriptionEn: Twenty years after a devastating flu has collapsed civilization, a traveling theater troupe journeys across the ruins of North America, performing Shakespeare for scattered survivors. Interweaving the world before and after the pandemic, this National Book Award finalist asks what remains when civilization falls—art, memory, and the small rituals that make us human.
books.whyReadEn: Re-evaluated as a masterpiece for its portrait of the world after a pandemic. What endures when civilization breaks? A new classic of dystopian literature. Elegant, haunting, and quietly hopeful.

books.title: The City & the City
books.author: China Miéville
books.authorJa: チャイナ・ミエヴィル
books.descriptionJa: 同じ土地に重なって存在しながら、互いを「見てはいけない」二つの都市、ベジェルとウル・コマ。殺人事件の捜査が、二つの都市の禁忌に踏み込んでいく。世界SF賞受賞。都市の政治と「見ること」をめぐる、異色のSFミステリ。
books.whyReadJa: 「見えてはいけないものを無視する」という社会的規律のSF化。現実の排他性を考える傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「見てはいけない」都市をめぐる、世界SF賞受賞のSFミステリ。
books.descriptionEn: Besžel and Ul Qoma are two cities that occupy the same physical space yet are forbidden to see each other. When a murder investigation forces its way past that prohibition, detective Tyador Borlú must navigate the strange social rules that keep them apart. Winner of the World Fantasy Award, this is an uncanny fusion of SF and mystery about politics, perception, and what we choose not to see.
books.whyReadEn: A brilliant SF rendition of the social discipline of ignoring what must not be seen. A masterpiece that makes you rethink exclusion and prejudice in the real world. Breathtakingly original.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.authorJa: スザンナ・クラーク
books.descriptionJa: 無数の広間と彫像が並ぶ巨大な「館」に住むピラネージ。彼はその館が「世界のすべて」だと信じている。しかし別の住人である「もう一人」が、彼に館の外の世界を教え始める。孤独と記憶をめぐる、静かで美しいファンタジー。
books.whyReadJa: 『ナルニア国物語』の著者クラークの復活作。世界で最も美しい構造物についての小説。
books.selectionReasonJa: 無限の館に住む男の物語。孤独と記憶の美しいファンタジー。
books.descriptionEn: Piranesi lives in a vast House of endless halls lined with statues, and believes the House is the entire world. He keeps a meticulous journal, recording the tides and the other—who visits only rarely. But as his one companion begins to reveal secrets of a world beyond the House, the foundations of his reality quietly shift. A serene, exquisite fantasy about solitude and memory.
books.whyReadEn: The triumphant return of the author of Jonathan Strange & Mr Norrell. A novel about the most beautiful structure in the world—quiet, strange, and unforgettable. Read it for its startling, gentle brilliance.

books.title: American Gods
books.author: Neil Gaiman
books.authorJa: ニール・ゲイマン
books.descriptionJa: オーディンやアナンシといった「古い神々」は、移民とともにアメリカに渡ってきた。しかし今、彼らは「テレビ・神」「インターネット・神」といった新しい神々に取って代わられようとしている。神々の戦争に巻き込まれた男シャドウの、アメリカ横断の物語。
books.whyReadJa: 「移民の神々」と「消費社会の神々」の戦争。アメリカという国を神話の視点から読む、壮大なファンタジー。
books.selectionReasonJa: 移民の神々と消費社会の神々の戦争を描く、ヒューゴー賞受賞作。
books.descriptionEn: The old gods—Odin, Anansi, and the rest—arrived in America with the immigrants who worshiped them. But now they are being displaced by new gods of television, the internet, and celebrity. When ex-con Shadow is drawn into their brewing war, he embarks on a wild journey across America. A sprawling fantasy that reads an entire nation through myth.
books.whyReadEn: A war between the gods of immigrants and the gods of consumer culture. A grand fantasy that reads America itself as mythology—road trip, epic, and meditation in one. Gaiman at his most ambitious.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.authorJa: J・R・R・トールキン
books.descriptionJa: 「ゆかいで、あなたにぴったりの一歩を踏み出す物語」。臆病なホビットのビルボが、ドワーフたちとともに竜の財宝を求めて旅に出る。ファンタジー文学の原型を築いた、トールキンの不朽の名作。
books.whyReadJa: ファンタジーを読むなら、必ず通る道。物語の黄金時代の始まりがここにある。
books.selectionReasonJa: ファンタジー文学の原型を築いた、トールキンの不朽の名作。
books.descriptionEn: A cheerful story about taking the first step that's right for you. Bilbo, a timid hobbit, joins a company of dwarves on a quest to reclaim a dragon's hoard—and discovers courage he never knew he had. The book that established the template for modern fantasy, and Tolkien's enduring classic, charming readers of every age.
books.whyReadEn: Everyone who reads fantasy walks this road. The beginning of storytelling's golden age lives here—warm, witty, and wonderfully adventurous. The perfect gateway to Middle-earth.

books.title: The Lord of the Rings
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.authorJa: J・R・R・トールキン
books.descriptionJa: 「一つの指輪はすべてを統べる」。世界を支配する力を持つ指輪を破壊するため、ホビットのフロドは危険な旅に出る。善と悪、友情と自己犠牲を描く、ファンタジー文学の頂点。
books.whyReadJa: ファンタジーの「聖書」。世界中の物語に影響を与えた、想像力の金字塔。
books.selectionReasonJa: ファンタジー文学の聖書。想像力の金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: One Ring to rule them all. To destroy the Ring that holds the power to dominate the world, the hobbit Frodo sets out on a perilous journey with the Fellowship of the Ring. A story of good and evil, friendship and self-sacrifice, this is the summit of fantasy literature—an epic whose influence on storytelling is immeasurable.
books.whyReadEn: The "Bible" of fantasy. A pinnacle of imagination that has shaped stories across the globe—once you begin, Middle-earth never lets you go. The defining epic of the genre.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.authorJa: パトリック・ロスファス
books.descriptionJa: 「伝説の魔術師」クォースが、自らの真実の物語を語り始める——貧しい旅一座の少年から、大学で魔法を学ぶまで。語りの美しさと、それに隠された秘密。ファンタジー界に衝撃を与えたデビュー作。
books.whyReadJa: 「語ること」を主題にした、最も美しいファンタジーの一つ。次巻が待ちきれなくなる中毒性。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「語ること」を主題にした、最も美しいファンタジー。
books.descriptionEn: The legendary wizard Kvothe begins to tell the truth of his own story—from a poor boy in a traveling troupe to a student of magic at the University. Rothfuss's debut stunned the fantasy world with the beauty of its prose and the secrets buried within it. A first-person epic as elegant and intricate as the music at its heart.
books.whyReadEn: One of the most beautiful fantasies ever written, taking storytelling itself as its subject. Highly addictive—you'll be desperate for the next volume. Prose this good is rare in any genre.

books.title: The Sandman
books.author: Neil Gaiman
books.authorJa: ニール・ゲイマン
books.descriptionJa: 「夢の主」モーフィアスことサンドマンは、囚われから解放され、失われた王国を再建する旅に出る。神話、文学、歴史を横断する、グラフィックノベル史上最も文学的で壮大な作品。
books.whyReadJa: コミックの枠を超えた「物語の殿堂」。文学ファンにも、是非読んでほしい一冊。
books.selectionReasonJa: コミックの枠を超えた、グラフィックノベル史上最も文学的で壮大な作品。
books.descriptionEn: Dream of the Endless, known as the Sandman, is released from captivity and sets out to reclaim the power and artifacts stolen from him, and to rebuild his shattered kingdom. Ranging across myth, literature, and history, it is the most literary and ambitious work in the history of the graphic novel—and one of the great achievements of modern storytelling.
books.whyReadEn: A cathedral of stories that transcends the comics form. Literary readers, this one is for you—Gaiman's masterwork and one of the great modern epics. Now a celebrated Netflix series.

books.title: A Psalm for the Wild-Built
books.author: Becky Chambers
books.authorJa: ベッキー・チェンバース
books.descriptionJa: ロボットが人間の元を離れて200年後の、環境再生が進む未来。お茶を淹れることに生きがいを見つけた修道士デクスは、「何が足りないのか」を求めて旅に出る。ソーラーパンクSFの金字塔。心が温かくなる、優しい未来。
books.whyReadJa: 「破滅ではなく再生」を描いた、ソーラーパンクの代表作。息苦しいSFに疲れた人に。
books.selectionReasonJa: 破滅ではなく再生を描く、ソーラーパンクの代表作。
books.descriptionEn: Two centuries after the robots left humanity, the world has begun to heal. Dex, a tea monk who finds purpose in serving perfect cups of tea, travels in search of the answer to a nagging question: what is it they're missing? When they meet a robot, the two set off on a gentle journey. A cornerstone of solarpunk SF—a warm, kind future that makes your heart ache.
books.whyReadEn: The defining work of solarpunk, imagining renewal instead of ruin. For anyone exhausted by grim, suffocating science fiction—a breath of kindness and hope. Short, sweet, and utterly human.

books.title: The War of the Worlds
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.authorJa: H・G・ウェルズ
books.descriptionJa: 火星人が空から降り立ち、イギリスを破壊する。新聞社が実際の事件として放送しパニックを起こした、SF黎明期の金字塔。地球外生命との接触というテーマの原型。
books.whyReadJa: 「エイリアン侵略」SFの原点。現在の宇宙SFのすべてはここから始まった。
books.selectionReasonJa: エイリアン侵略SFの原点。火星人とイギリスの戦い。
books.descriptionEn: Martians descend from the sky and lay waste to England. Wells's tale is the cornerstone of early science fiction—so convincing that a radio broadcast of it in 1938 panicked real listeners. It established the template for contact with alien life and remains a thrilling, chilling read today.
books.whyReadEn: The origin of alien-invasion science fiction. Every work of modern space SF traces back to this—and the panic it caused is a story in itself. A century-old thriller that still works.

books.title: The Time Machine
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.authorJa: H・G・ウェルズ
books.descriptionJa: 時間旅行者（タイム・トラベラー）が、80万年後の未来へ旅する。エロイとモーロック——階級が進化した二種族の世界。タイムトラベルというジャンルを作った、SFの原典。
books.whyReadJa: 「時間」をSFにした最初の名作。未来社会の比喩としても深い。
books.selectionReasonJa: タイムトラベルというジャンルを作った、SFの原典。
books.descriptionEn: The Time Traveller journeys eight hundred thousand years into the future, to a world of the gentle Eloi and the subterranean Morlocks—two races born of an evolved class divide. The novel that founded the genre of time travel, it is SF's original text, at once a thrilling adventure and a sharp fable about the future of society.
books.whyReadEn: The first great novel to make time a subject of science fiction. And as a metaphor for future society, it cuts deeper than ever. A short, essential classic.

books.title: The Invisible Man
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.authorJa: H・G・ウェルズ
books.descriptionJa: 透明になることに成功した科学者グリフィン。しかし目に見えない彼は、社会から追い詰められ、暴走していく。科学の欲望と人間性の喪失を描く、ウェルズのSF傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「見えない力」を持つ人間の孤立。サイエンス・フィクションの名作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 透明になる科学者の暴走を描く、ウェルズのSF傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Scientist Griffin achieves the impossible: making himself invisible. But invisible and unaccountable, he is driven to the margins of society and gradually to madness. A brilliant study in the corruption of power and the loss of humanity, The Invisible Man is one of Wells's sharpest science-fictional fables, as gripping now as when it first appeared.
books.whyReadEn: The isolation of a man with unseen power—and what it does to him. A classic of science fiction, and eerily relevant to a world of anonymous influence.

books.title: The Island of Doctor Moreau
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.authorJa: H・G・ウェルズ
books.descriptionJa: 動物を人間に改造するモロー博士の孤島。人間と動物の境界をめぐる、禁じられた科学の物語。バイオエシックスを先取りした、SFの古典中の古典。
books.whyReadJa: 「人間とは何か」をSFで問う。科学と倫理の原点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 人間と動物の境界を問う、バイオエシックスの先駆け。
books.descriptionEn: On a remote island, Doctor Moreau reshapes animals into human form—a forbidden experiment in creation. The islanders he makes struggle to cling to a Law they can barely follow, while the narrator is forced to watch the line between human and beast blur. A classic among classics, anticipating bioethics decades before the word existed.
books.whyReadEn: Science fiction asking what makes us human. The origin point of the debate between science and ethics—and as disturbing today as in 1896. Short, brutal, unforgettable.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.titleJa: フランケンシュタイン
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.authorJa: メアリー・シェリー
books.descriptionJa: 生命を創造した科学者フランケンシュタイン。しかし、その「怪物」は愛を求め、世界に絶望していく。SFとホラーと人間性の問いをすべて含む、近代ゴシックの原点。
books.whyReadJa: 「創造者と被造物」の物語。すべてのAI・ロボット物語の原型。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「創造者と被造物」の物語。すべてのAI・ロボット物語の原型。
books.descriptionEn: Victor Frankenstein creates life—and abandons his creature. The monster, longing only for love, is met with horror and despair, and turns to vengeance. Containing the seeds of science fiction, horror, and the question of what we owe what we create, this is the origin of modern Gothic literature and the prototype of every AI and robot story.
books.whyReadEn: The story of creator and created. The archetype of every AI and robot narrative—and a haunting meditation on responsibility that grows more urgent by the year.

books.title: Voyage au centre de la Terre
books.author: Jules Verne
books.authorJa: ジュール・ヴェルヌ
books.descriptionJa: 教授と甥、そして案内人が、氷河の火口から地球の中心へと降りていく。冒険SFの父ヴェルヌの、恐竜と海が待つ地下世界への旅。
books.whyReadJa: 「探検SF」の原型。科学と冒険が融合した、ヴェルヌの代表作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 探検SFの原型。ヴェルヌの地底冒険。
books.titleEn: Journey to the Centre of the Earth
books.descriptionEn: A professor, his nephew, and their guide descend into the Earth through a volcano in Iceland, toward a hidden world of caverns, ancient seas, and living dinosaurs. From the father of adventure science fiction comes a journey into the deep that still stirs the imagination—a blueprint for every exploration story that followed.
books.whyReadEn: The prototype of exploration science fiction. Verne's representative work, where science and adventure fuse into pure delight. A must for fans of discovery and wonder.

books.title: Vingt mille lieues sous les mers
books.author: Jules Verne
books.authorJa: ジュール・ヴェルヌ
books.descriptionJa: 謎の巨大生物の調査に赴いた科学者たちが、潜水艦ノーチラス号とネモ船長に囚われる。神秘の海底世界を描く、海洋SFの最高傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「海の神秘」と「孤独な天才」の物語。ヴェルヌの最高傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 海洋SFの最高傑作。ネモ船長とノーチラス号。
books.titleEn: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Seas
books.descriptionEn: Chasing a mysterious sea monster, Professor Aronnax and his companions are captured by Captain Nemo aboard the submarine Nautilus. They are carried through a secret, luminous underwater world—of coral forests, lost treasure, and the South Pole—in the greatest sea story in all of science fiction, a voyage of wonder and ambiguous freedom.
books.whyReadEn: The mysteries of the sea and a lonely genius in one novel. Verne's masterpiece—and the undersea journey of a lifetime. Endlessly adapted, never surpassed.

books.title: The First Men in the Moon
books.author: H.G. Wells
books.authorJa: H・G・ウェルズ
books.descriptionJa: 反重力物質「カヴォライト」で月へ向かった二人の男。月の地下に広がる、昆虫型の知的生命の社会。月面探検の物語として、最も早く書かれたSFの一つ。
books.whyReadJa: 「月」を舞台にした最初期のSF。ウェルズの想像力の原点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 月を舞台にした最初期のSF。ウェルズの想像力の原点。
books.titleEn: The First Men in the Moon
books.descriptionEn: With the anti-gravity substance Cavorite, two men fly to the Moon—and find a civilization beneath its surface: a vast society of insect-like, intelligent beings ruled by a Grand Lunar. One of the earliest stories ever written about exploring the Moon, it shows Wells's imagination at full power, mixing satire, wonder, and colonial anxiety.
books.whyReadEn: Among the very first science fiction set on the Moon. Wells's imagination at its origin—a strange, funny, unsettling voyage. A must-read for fans of early SF.

books.title: Childhood's End
books.author: Arthur C. Clarke
books.authorJa: アーサー・C・クラーク
books.descriptionJa: 地球を支配した「オーバーロード」は、人類を導くために来たのではなく、人類の「進化の終着点」を待っていた。地球外生命と人類の未来を描く、SF黄金期の最高傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「人類の次」を描く、最も壮大なSF。クラークの代表作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 人類の「進化の終着点」を描く、クラークの代表作。
books.descriptionEn: The Overlords come to rule Earth—not to guide humanity, but to shepherd it toward the end point of its evolution. For fifty years they bring peace and prosperity, yet their true purpose, and their own shrouded appearance, hold a secret that will transform the human race forever. A masterpiece of science fiction's Golden Age about aliens, transcendence, and what comes after humanity.
books.whyReadEn: The grandest science fiction about what comes after humanity. Clarke's representative masterpiece—a book that expands the mind. Its final chapters are among SF's most awe-inspiring.

books.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
books.author: Arthur C. Clarke
books.authorJa: アーサー・C・クラーク
books.descriptionJa: 神秘のモノリス。自我を持つコンピュータHAL9000。人類の進化と宇宙の謎をめぐる、SF史上最も影響力のある物語。映画と小説の両方で語り継がれる傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「AI」と「人類の進化」を描いた、宇宙SFの最高峰。
books.selectionReasonJa: AIと人類の進化を描く、宇宙SFの最高峰。
books.descriptionEn: A mysterious black monolith. HAL 9000, a computer with a mind and fears of its own. From the dawn of human evolution to the far reaches of the solar system, this is the most influential story in science-fiction history, told in both novel and film with equal power. A meditation on intelligence, evolution, and what lies beyond.
books.whyReadEn: The summit of space science fiction, uniting AI and human evolution in one vision. The film changed cinema; the novel deepens the mystery. Essential reading.

books.title: Rendezvous with Rama
books.author: Arthur C. Clarke
books.authorJa: アーサー・C・クラーク
books.descriptionJa: 太陽系に突入してきた謎の巨大物体「ラマ」。人類はその内部を調査するが、それは未知の宇宙船だった。ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞。未知との遭遇SFの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「未知の物体との接触」をリアルに描く、ハードSFの金字塔。
books.selectionReasonJa: 未知の物体との接触をリアルに描く、ハードSFの金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: A vast, mysterious object named Rama hurtles through the solar system, and humanity scrambles to investigate it. Inside, explorers find a world of artificial seas and alien architecture—a starship built by beings who never appear. Winner of both the Hugo and Nebula Awards, this is hard SF at its finest, and the definitive encounter with the unknown.
books.whyReadEn: A landmark of hard science fiction that renders contact with the unknown with total realism. Pure wonder, pure exploration. Hugo and Nebula winner—and deservedly so.

books.title: Ender's Game
books.author: Orson Scott Card
books.authorJa: オーソン・スコット・カード
books.descriptionJa: 天才児エンダーは、宇宙戦争の指揮官になるために、ゲームで「訓練」される。しかし、そのゲームの本当の意味を知ったとき——。戦争と教育と倫理を問う、SFの金字塔。ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞。
books.whyReadJa: 「子どもと戦争」を描く、SF史に残る傑作。映画化もされた。
books.selectionReasonJa: 子どもと戦争を描く、ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞の金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: Ender Wiggin, a brilliant child, is trained as a commander for humanity's war against an alien species—through games. But when he finally learns what the games truly are, the cost of victory cuts to the bone. A Hugo and Nebula Award winner that probes war, education, and ethics through the eyes of a child soldier. A cornerstone of science fiction.
books.whyReadEn: A landmark novel about children and war, unforgettable and morally devastating. Also adapted into a film. Essential SF. The twist is one of the greats of the genre.

books.title: Speaker for the Dead
books.author: Orson Scott Card
books.authorJa: オーソン・スコット・カード
books.descriptionJa: エンダーは、「死者の代弁者」として別の惑星の植民地に赴き、異星種族「ペキニーノ」の謎に挑む。シリーズ第二作。ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞。
books.whyReadJa: 「異種族との和解」を描く、エンダーシリーズの頂点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 異種族との和解を描く、エンダーシリーズの頂点。
books.descriptionEn: Thousands of years after the events of Ender's Game, Ender has become the Speaker for the Dead, telling the truth of the dead to the living. On a distant colony he confronts the mystery of the pig-like alien race, the Pequeninos, and the misunderstandings that killed them. Hugo and Nebula Award winner, and the heart of the Ender saga.
books.whyReadEn: The peak of the Ender series, about reconciliation between species. Deeper and stranger than the first book—and in many ways better. A novel about truth, guilt, and atonement.

books.title: The Lathe of Heaven
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.authorJa: アーシュラ・K・ル＝グウィン
books.descriptionJa: 夢で現実を書き換えてしまう男ジョージ・オア。精神科医は彼の能力を利用し、世界を「より良く」作り替えようとする。現実の本質を問う、ル＝グウィンの傑作SF。
books.whyReadJa: 「夢と現実」をめぐる、知的なSF。ル＝グウィンの最高傑作の一つ。
books.selectionReasonJa: 夢で現実を書き換える男を描く、ル＝グウィンの傑作SF。
books.descriptionEn: George Orr has dreams that rewrite reality—and only he can remember the world as it was. When his psychiatrist decides to harness this gift to "improve" the world, each well-meaning change creates a new, often darker reality. A witty, unsettling classic that asks what reality is made of, and whether utopia can be dreamed into being.
books.whyReadEn: A sharply intelligent science fiction novel about dreams and reality—one of Le Guin's very best. Darkly funny, endlessly thought-provoking. A hidden gem of 1970s SF.

books.title: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress
books.titleJa: 月は無慈悲な夜の女王
books.author: Robert A. Heinlein
books.authorJa: ロバート・A・ハインライン
books.descriptionJa: 月の流刑地は、地球からの独立を計画する。自己意識を持つコンピュータ・マイクとともに、月の反乱を描く。ハインラインの代表作で、自由と政治のSF。
books.whyReadJa: 「月の独立戦争」を描く、政治的SFの最高峰。
books.selectionReasonJa: 月の独立戦争を描く、政治的SFの最高峰。
books.titleEn: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress
books.descriptionEn: The Moon, a penal colony, plots revolution against Earth. Joining the conspirators is Mike, a self-aware computer, and the one man who can speak to it. Told with wit, political passion, and a forged-in-hard-rock sense of liberty, this is Heinlein's most beloved novel and one of the great works of political science fiction.
books.whyReadEn: The lunar revolution—a masterpiece of political science fiction about freedom. Witty, suspenseful, and endlessly quotable. Hugo and Nebula winner, and Heinlein's finest.

books.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
books.author: Robert A. Heinlein
books.authorJa: ロバート・A・ハインライン
books.descriptionJa: 火星で育った人間ヴァレンタイン・マイケル・スミスが、地球に来て文明の「タブー」を破っていく。愛と宗教と自由を問う、1960年代カウンターカルチャーの聖典。
books.whyReadJa: 「自由とは何か」をSFで問う。ヒッピー世代に影響を与えた名著。
books.selectionReasonJa: 火星育ちの人間が地球のタブーを破る、60年代カウンターカルチャーの聖典。
books.descriptionEn: Valentine Michael Smith, raised by Martians, returns to Earth and sees human civilization through entirely alien eyes—questioning every taboo we take for granted: love, sex, religion, death. A founding text of 1960s counterculture and one of the best-selling science-fiction novels ever, it became a Bible for a generation searching for new forms of freedom.
books.whyReadEn: Science fiction asking what freedom really means. The novel that influenced the hippie generation—strange, radical, and visionary. Also a landmark of 60s culture.

books.title: The Drowned World
books.author: J.G. Ballard
books.authorJa: J・G・バラード
books.descriptionJa: 太陽フレアで氷河が溶け、海水が大陸を呑み込んだ未来。水没したロンドンで、人間は「退行」していく。環境破壊と精神の変容を描く、気候SFの先駆け。
books.whyReadJa: 「気候崩壊後」を描いた最初のSF。環境文学の原点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 気候崩壊後を描いた最初のSF。環境文学の原点。
books.descriptionEn: After a solar flare melts the ice caps, rising seas swallow the continents. In a drowned, tropical London, humans begin to regress—their dreams and desires drawn backward into an earlier, more primitive self. A pioneering work of climate fiction, The Drowned World fuses environmental collapse with psychological transformation in Ballard's uniquely unsettling prose.
books.whyReadEn: One of the first science-fiction novels about life after climate collapse. The origin of environmental literature—dreamlike and disturbingly beautiful. A must for readers of climate fiction.

books.title: On the Beach
books.author: Nevil Shute
books.authorJa: ネヴィル・シュート
books.country: イギリス/オーストラリア
books.descriptionJa: 核戦争の放射能雲が、少しずつ南半球へ迫る。滅びゆく世界で、人々はどのように日常を送るのか。SFであると同時に、人類の終末をめぐる最も静かな警告。
books.whyReadJa: 「核戦争後の世界」を描く、最初期の終末SF。現在のディストピアの原点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 核戦争後の世界を描く、最初期の終末SF。
books.descriptionEn: After a nuclear war has ended the Northern Hemisphere, a cloud of lethal radiation drifts slowly south. In Australia, ordinary people face their final months—tending gardens, falling in love, waiting. Simultaneously science fiction and the quietest of warnings about humanity's end, this is a devastating portrait of how we might live as the world ends.
books.whyReadEn: An early end-of-the-world novel about life after nuclear war. The quiet origin of today's dystopias—and shattering in its calm. A slow, devastating masterpiece.

books.title: The Martian Chronicles
books.author: Ray Bradbury
books.authorJa: レイ・ブラッドベリ
books.descriptionJa: 火星入植の物語を、詩的な断章として紡ぐ。火星の古代文明と、地球人の入植の結末。ブラッドベリの叙情とSFが融合した、火星をめぐる文学の古典。
books.whyReadJa: 「火星」を詩として描く。ブラッドベリの最も美しいSF。
books.selectionReasonJa: 火星を詩として描く、ブラッドベリの最も美しいSF。
books.descriptionEn: A chain of poetic episodes traces humanity's colonization of Mars—from first fragile landings to the extinction of an ancient Martian civilization and the strange fate of the settlers. Bradbury's lyricism and science fiction fuse into a haunting, bittersweet chronicle. The definitive literary portrait of Mars, and a classic of poetic imagination.
books.whyReadEn: Mars written as poetry. Bradbury's most beautiful science fiction—wistful, strange, and luminous. Each chapter is a small masterpiece; together they form an elegy for both worlds.

books.title: The Day of the Triffids
books.author: John Wyndham
books.authorJa: ジョン・ウィンダム
books.descriptionJa: 彗星の光が世界中の人間の視力を奪う。そして、動く植物「トリフィド」が人類を襲う。パンデミック後世界のSF古典。文明の脆弱さを描く。
books.whyReadJa: 「文明崩壊」を描くSFの原型。現在のパンデミック文学の祖先。
books.selectionReasonJa: 文明崩壊を描くSFの原型。パンデミック文学の祖先。
books.descriptionEn: A spectacular comet shower leaves most of humanity blind. In the confusion, the triffids—farmed, mobile, carnivorous plants—begin to rise against their keepers. A classic of post-apocalyptic science fiction, The Day of the Triffids is a chilling study of civilization's fragility, told through the few who kept their sight.
books.whyReadEn: The prototype of the civilization-collapse story—and the ancestor of today's pandemic literature. Its premise remains unnervingly plausible. Suspenseful and thoughtful in equal measure.

books.title: The Midwich Cuckoos
books.titleJa: ミッドウィッチのカッコウ
books.author: John Wyndham
books.authorJa: ジョン・ウィンダム
books.descriptionJa: ある日、イギリスの村の全員が気絶する。そして、村の全ての女性が妊娠していた。異星人の子供「カッコウ」たちとの対峙を描く、SFミステリの傑作。映画『ビレッジ・オブ・ザ・ダムド』の原作。
books.whyReadJa: 「異星人の子」をめぐる、知的な恐怖。ウィンダムの代表作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 異星人の子をめぐる、SFミステリの傑作。
books.descriptionEn: One day, everyone in the English village of Midwich falls unconscious. When they wake, every woman of childbearing age is pregnant. The children who are born share a strange bond and a chilling power—and their arrival forces the village to confront an impossible choice. The basis for the film Village of the Damned, this is a masterpiece of SF suspense.
books.whyReadEn: An intellectual horror about the children of an alien race. Wyndham's representative work—quiet on the surface, terrifying underneath. One of the great "quiet invasion" stories.

books.title: The Chrysalids
books.author: John Wyndham
books.authorJa: ジョン・ウィンダム
books.descriptionJa: 核戦争後の世界で、遺伝子の「変異」を狩る社会。テレパシーを持つ少年デビッドは、異端として追われる。差異をめぐる、ウィンダムの最も深いSF。
books.whyReadJa: 「異質な者」への迫害を描く。差別とアイデンティティのSF。
books.selectionReasonJa: 差異と迫害を描く、ウィンダムの最も深いSF。
books.descriptionEn: In a strict post-nuclear community, purity of form is a religion and any genetic deviation is cast out, even one's own child. Young David conceals a dangerous secret: he can read minds. As his hidden gift is hunted, Wyndham builds his most profound science fiction—a story about difference, persecution, and what we fear in others.
books.whyReadEn: Science fiction about the persecution of those who are different. A powerful fable of discrimination and identity—sad, thrilling, and essential. Wyndham's most thoughtful work.

books.title: The Forever War
books.author: Joe Haldeman
books.authorJa: ジョー・ホールドマン
books.descriptionJa: 光速戦争で戦う兵士たちは、戦争のたびに時間が経過する宇宙で「戻る」たびに、社会が変化している。ベトナム戦争を経験した作者が描く、時間と戦争のSF傑作。ヒューゴー賞・ネビュラ賞受賞。
books.whyReadJa: 「戦争と時間」を描く、反戦SFの金字塔。
books.selectionReasonJa: 時間と戦争を描く、反戦SFの金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: Fighting a war that spans light-years, soldiers experience relativistic time: each tour of duty returns them to a home decades older than the one they left. Joe Haldeman, a Vietnam veteran, channels his own war into this Hugo and Nebula Award-winning novel—an extraordinary study of time, alienation, and the absurd machinery of war.
books.whyReadEn: A masterwork of anti-war science fiction about time and battle. Written by a Vietnam veteran, it has lost none of its power to shake the reader. Hugo and Nebula winner.

books.title: The Door into Summer
books.author: Robert A. Heinlein
books.authorJa: ロバート・A・ハインライン
books.descriptionJa: 冷凍睡眠で未来へ跳ぶ発明家ダニエル・デイビス。裏切り、猫、そして「夏への扉」——ハインラインの中でも最も愛される、タイムトラベルとロボットの物語。
books.whyReadJa: 「猫とタイムトラベル」の名作。ハインラインの入門に最適。
books.selectionReasonJa: 猫とタイムトラベルの名作。ハインラインの入門に最適。
books.descriptionEn: Inventor Dan Davis is betrayed, robbed of everything, and frozen into a decades-long sleep. Waking in a future he doesn't recognize, he searches for the door into summer—and for the beloved cat Pete—in a tale of revenge, robotics, and time travel. Heinlein's most beloved novel: warm, clever, and irresistibly romantic.
books.whyReadEn: A beloved classic of cats and time travel. The perfect introduction to Heinlein—witty, warm, and endlessly rereadable. One of the most charming novels in all of SF.

books.title: The Stars My Destination
books.author: Alfred Bester
books.authorJa: アルフレッド・ベスター
books.descriptionJa: 瞬間移動（ジャンテ）が普及した未来。復讐に燃える男ガリ・グレイの物語。SF史上最もハードボイルドで、ウィリアム・ギブスンやフィリップ・K・ディックに影響を与えた。
books.whyReadJa: 「復讐」をめぐるSFの最高傑作。サイバーパンクの源流。
books.selectionReasonJa: 復讐をめぐるSFの最高傑作。サイバーパンクの源流。
books.descriptionEn: In a future where teleportation—"jaunting"—has transformed the world, disfigured wreck survivor Gulliver Foyle, outcast and underestimated, burns with a single purpose: revenge. The most hard-boiled novel in science-fiction history, it electrified the genre and influenced writers from William Gibson to Philip K. Dick. Furious, stylish, and impossible to set down.
books.whyReadEn: The finest revenge story in science fiction—and the source of cyberpunk. As much a thriller as SF, with a protagonist you won't forget. Bester changed the genre forever.

books.title: Zone One
books.author: Colson Whitehead
books.authorJa: コルソン・ホワイトヘッド
books.descriptionJa: ゾンビ疫病後のマンハッタン。掃討部隊の一員として、壊れた世界を歩く男の日常。ピューリッツァー賞作家が描く、ゾンビ文学の知的な傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「終末後の日常」を描く、文学的ゾンビ小説。ホワイトヘッドの異色作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 終末後の日常を描く、ピューリッツァー賞作家のゾンビ文学。
books.descriptionEn: After the zombie plague, Manhattan is being reclaimed—one building at a time. Mark Spitz, a "sweeper" assigned to clear the Zone, walks the streets of a broken city, observing the strangeness of the survivors and the monotony of apocalypse. A Pulitzer Prize-winning novelist's intellectual take on the zombie genre: literary, wry, and quietly devastating.
books.whyReadEn: A literary zombie novel about the ordinary texture of life after the end of the world. Whitehead's oddest, most intelligent book—and a stinging portrait of America. Post-apocalyptic fiction for grown-ups.

books.title: Sea of Tranquility
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.authorJa: エミリー・セント・ジョン・マンデル
books.descriptionJa: 1912年、2020年、2203年、2401年——四つの時代に現れる、時間と空間を超えた「異変」。宇宙植民地とシミュレーションをめぐる、マンデルの傑作SF。
books.whyReadJa: 『ステーション・イレブン』の著者が描く、時空をめぐる新しい物語。
books.selectionReasonJa: 四つの時代を超える、マンデルの時空SF。
books.descriptionEn: An anomaly ripples across four eras—1912, 2020, 2203, and 2401—connecting a young exile in the Canadian wilderness, a novelist in a pandemic city, and a girl raised on a lunar colony. As the threads converge, Mandel builds a graceful, mind-expanding novel about time, simulation, and what it means to be real. Her finest science fiction yet.
books.whyReadEn: A new story about time and space from the author of Station Eleven. Elegant, eerie, and structurally brilliant—science fiction for literary readers. Her best since Station Eleven.

books.title: The Glass Hotel
books.author: Emily St. John Mandel
books.authorJa: エミリー・セント・ジョン・マンデル
books.descriptionJa: バンクーバー島のガラスのホテルに現れる女の幻。金融詐欺、沈没したタンカー、そして失踪。『ステーション・イレブン』の著者が描く、現代の寓話。
books.whyReadJa: 「消える人」と「残る人」を描く、マンデルの成熟した傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「消える人」と「残る人」を描く、マンデルの成熟した傑作。
books.descriptionEn: A ghost haunts a glass hotel on Vancouver Island. A Ponzi scheme collapses. A woman vanishes from a ship at sea. Mandel weaves these threads—fraud, grief, and disappearance—into a modern fable of money, memory, and the people who slip through the cracks. A cool, exquisite novel from the author of Station Eleven.
books.whyReadEn: A story of those who disappear and those who remain. Mandel's mature, polished masterpiece—luminous and quietly devastating. Haunting in the best sense.

books.title: The Light of Other Days
books.author: Stephen Baxter
books.authorJa: スティーヴン・バクスター
books.descriptionJa: 「ワームホール望遠鏡」が発明され、過去を見ることが可能になる。歴史のすべてが明らかになった世界で、プライバシーとは何か。アーサー・C・クラークとの共著。
books.whyReadJa: 「過去を見る」技術がもたらす倫理。ハードSFの知的な傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「過去を見る」技術の倫理を問う、ハードSFの知的な傑作。
books.descriptionEn: The invention of wormhole telescopes makes the entire past visible: every moment, every secret, every private act. In a world where nothing is hidden, what happens to privacy—and to truth itself? A collaboration with Arthur C. Clarke, this is a rigorous hard-SF thought experiment and a startling meditation on the ethics of seeing everything.
books.whyReadEn: The ethics of a technology that lets us see the past. A sharply intellectual hard-SF masterpiece, co-written with Arthur C. Clarke. A book that will change how you think about memory and surveillance.

books.title: The Dark Forest
books.author: Cixin Liu
books.authorJa: 劉慈欣
books.descriptionJa: 『三体』の続編。宇宙文明の「暗黒の森の法則」——宇宙は無数の狩人が、互いを殺し合う暗黒の森である。宇宙社会学という、劉慈欣が打ち立てた独創的なSF世界の頂点。
books.whyReadJa: 「宇宙の暗黒の森」という概念。三体シリーズの核心にして、現代SFの最高峰。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「暗黒の森の法則」を打ち立てた、『三体』の核心。
books.descriptionEn: The sequel to The Three-Body Problem. Facing an alien invasion four centuries away, humanity discovers the Dark Forest theory of the universe: a cosmos in which countless hunters must destroy each other on sight. It is the summit of Liu Cixin's invention of "cosmic sociology"—a chilling, awe-inspiring expansion of science fiction's horizons.
books.whyReadEn: The Dark Forest—the concept at the heart of the Three-Body trilogy, and one of modern SF's highest peaks. Read it for the ideas alone.

books.title: Death's End
books.author: Cixin Liu
books.authorJa: 劉慈欣
books.descriptionJa: 『三体』三部作の最終章。宇宙の滅亡と人類の選択、そして「宇宙の再誕」の可能性。劉慈欣の壮大な宇宙観が、完結に向けて疾走する。
books.whyReadJa: 「三体」シリーズの集大成。宇宙の行く末を描く、スケールの頂点。
books.selectionReasonJa: 『三体』三部作の集大成。宇宙の行く末を描くスケールの頂点。
books.descriptionEn: The final volume of the Three-Body trilogy. As civilizations wage war across the cosmos, humanity faces its most terrible choice—and the possibility of cosmic rebirth. Liu Cixin's vision accelerates toward a conclusion of staggering scale, taking in love, despair, and the fate of the universe itself. The capstone of a landmark trilogy.
books.whyReadEn: The culmination of the Three-Body trilogy, and the scale reaches its peak. A novel about the fate of the universe that will leave you breathless. A monumental ending.

books.title: We
books.author: Yevgeny Zamyatin
books.authorYa: エフゲニー・ザミャーチン
books.authorJa: エフゲニー・ザミャーチン
books.descriptionJa: 数学的に管理された「単一国家」。ディストピア文学の原点として、オーウェルとハクスリーに影響を与えた、ロシアSFの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「ディストピア文学の祖」。1984年とすばらしい新世界の原型。
books.selectionReasonJa: ディストピア文学の祖。オーウェルとハクスリーの原型。
books.descriptionEn: In the One State, lives are regulated by mathematics, schedules, and the all-seeing Benefactor—even love requires a permit. When engineer D-503 begins to feel the stirrings of a soul, his perfect world begins to crack. The founding text of dystopian literature, We directly inspired both Orwell's 1984 and Huxley's Brave New World.
books.whyReadEn: The ancestor of all dystopian fiction. The prototype of 1984 and Brave New World—a razor-sharp, feverish classic that still cuts deep. Essential for any reader of dystopia.

books.title: The Man in the High Castle
books.author: Philip K. Dick
books.authorJa: フィリップ・K・ディック
books.descriptionJa: もしも枢軸国が第二次世界大戦に勝っていたら——日本とドイツが世界を分け合う1962年。ディックが「if」の歴史を描いた、並行歴史SFの古典。ヒューゴー賞受賞。
books.whyReadJa: 「もし歴史が違っていたら」を描く、ヒューゴー賞受賞の傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 枢軸国が勝っていた世界を描く、ヒューゴー賞受賞の並行歴史SF。
books.titleEn: The Man in the High Castle
books.descriptionEn: The Axis powers won the war. In 1962, Japan and Germany divide a conquered America, while the occupied Pacific states live under Imperial rule. Among the traders, spies, and ordinary people of San Francisco, one man writes a banned alternate history of his own. A Hugo Award-winning classic of alternate history—and a dizzying meditation on what is real.
books.whyReadEn: What if history had gone differently? A Hugo-winning masterpiece of alternate history—and one of Dick's most unsettling puzzles. Now a celebrated Amazon series.

books.title: VALIS
books.author: Philip K. Dick
books.authorJa: フィリップ・K・ディック
books.descriptionJa: 神が「ヴァリス」という衛星から映像を送ってきた——自らの神秘体験をSF化した、ディック晩年の問題作。現実と幻覚の境界を問う、狂気と悟りの文学。
books.whyReadJa: 「現実とは何か」を極限まで問う、ディック文学の集大成。
books.selectionReasonJa: 神からの映像を受け取る男を描く、ディック晩年の問題作。
books.descriptionEn: A pink beam of light, a satellite called VALIS, and visions that may be God—or madness. Philip K. Dick turned his own mystical experiences into his most personal and radical novel: a fevered inquiry into reality, hallucination, and salvation. Late Dick at his most extreme, it stands as the culmination of his lifelong question: what is real?
books.whyReadEn: The ultimate inquiry into what reality is—the summa of Dick's work. Confessional, feverish, and utterly unique. A descent into madness and illumination.

books.title: Ubik
books.author: Philip K. Dick
books.authorJa: フィリップ・K・ディック
books.descriptionJa: 死者の意識が半死半生の状態で生き続ける世界。時間が逆行するなかで、現実の境界が揺らぐ。「ユービック」という万能の物質をめぐる、ディックの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「現実の崩壊」を描く、ディックの最高傑作の一つ。
books.selectionReasonJa: 現実の崩壊を描く、ディックの最高傑作の一つ。
books.descriptionEn: In a world where the dead can linger in half-life, consulted like oracles, reality itself begins to rot. Time runs backward, advertisements turn sinister, and only Ubik—a spray can of everything—stands between the characters and dissolution. One of Dick's finest novels, a dizzying exploration of reality's collapse, corporate dread, and grace.
books.whyReadEn: Dick's greatest work about the collapse of reality. Funny, terrifying, and profound—the Ubik can has entered the SF canon. A masterpiece of paranoid imagination.

books.title: The Crying of Lot 49
books.author: Thomas Pynchon
books.authorJa: トマス・ピンチョン
books.descriptionJa: 元夫の遺産相続をめぐり、謎の「トリステロ」という地下組織の痕跡を追う主婦オーディパ。ポストモダン文学の傑作にして、最も短く入門しやすいピンチョン。
books.whyReadJa: 「陰謀と記号」をめぐるポストモダン文学の古典。
books.selectionReasonJa: 陰謀と記号をめぐる、ポストモダン文学の古典。
books.descriptionEn: As executor of her ex-husband's estate, Oedipa Maas stumbles on the shadowy sign of a secret postal system called Tristero—and follows it into a labyrinth of plots, symbols, and madness. Postmodern literature's classic of conspiracy and signs, and the shortest, most accessible doorway into Pynchon's strange world.
books.whyReadEn: The classic postmodern novel of conspiracies and signs. Pynchon's shortest and most approachable—a brilliant, paranoid puzzle. You'll finish it and immediately read it again.

books.title: The City of Glass
books.author: Paul Auster
books.authorJa: ポール・オースター
books.descriptionJa: 探偵小説家クインは、間違い電話で「探偵」を依頼され、尾行を始める。しかし尾行の対象は、尾行する彼を尾行していた——。ポストモダン・ミステリの傑作。
books.whyReadJa: 「ニューヨーク三部作」の第一作。探偵小説の枠を破る傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 探偵小説の枠を破る、ポール・オースターの傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Quinn, a writer of detective novels, is hired as a private eye by a wrong-number call—and begins to tail a man. But the man he follows seems to be tailing him in return, and the case folds inward like a hall of mirrors. The first volume of Paul Auster's New York Trilogy, this is a postmodern mystery that dissolves the very idea of detection.
books.whyReadEn: The opening of the New York Trilogy—a masterpiece that breaks the detective novel wide open. Short, strange, and endlessly intriguing. A mirror maze for the mind.

books.title: The Night Circus
books.author: Erin Morgenstern
books.authorJa: エリン・モーゲンスターン
books.descriptionJa: 夜だけ開かれる幻のサーカス「ル・シルク・デ・レーヴ」。その中で、二人の魔術師の弟子が決闘を続ける。美しく幻想的な世界で繰り広げられる、愛と魔法の物語。
books.whyReadJa: 「夜のサーカス」の世界観が圧倒的。ファンタジーと恋愛の傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 夜のサーカスをめぐる、ファンタジーと恋愛の傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Le Cirque des Rêves appears without warning, opening only at night, in black and white. Within its tents, two young magicians—Celia and Marco—are locked in a magical duel by their masters, their feats growing ever more astonishing. But the circus is bound to the duel, and its fate hangs on their love. A lush, dreamlike novel of magic and romance.
books.whyReadEn: The world of the Night Circus is overwhelming. A masterpiece where fantasy and romance entwine—a feast for the senses. No one who enters its tents will leave unchanged.

books.title: The Slow Regard of Silent Things
books.titleJa: 静かなものたちの静かな敬愛
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.authorJa: パトリック・ロスファス
books.descriptionJa: 『風の名前』の登場人物アウリの、大学地下での孤独な物語。物語がほとんど起きない「静かな」一冊が、ファンタジーの可能性を広げた。ロスファスの異色作。
books.whyReadJa: 「物語のない物語」の試み。ファンタジー文学の実験。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「物語のない物語」の試み。ファンタジー文学の実験。
books.titleEn: The Slow Regard of Silent Things
books.descriptionEn: In the caverns beneath the University, Auri—a character from The Name of the Wind—tends her small, strange world with obsessive care, arranging objects and seeking what each one needs. Almost nothing happens, and yet everything unfolds. A quiet, luminous novella that expanded the possibilities of fantasy fiction, and one of Rothfuss's boldest experiments.
books.whyReadEn: An experiment: a story in which almost nothing happens. Rothfuss expands the boundaries of fantasy literature—delicate, strange, and beautiful. A love letter to solitude.

books.title: The Eye of the World
books.author: Robert Jordan
books.authorJa: ロバート・ジョーダン
books.descriptionJa: 時の車輪は回り続け、英雄は再び生まれる。15巻に及ぶ超大河ファンタジー『時の車輪』の開幕。村の少年ランドが、運命に引き込まれていく。
books.whyReadJa: 「英雄の旅」を極めた、現代ファンタジーの金字塔。
books.selectionReasonJa: 「英雄の旅」を極めた、現代ファンタジーの金字塔。
books.descriptionEn: The Wheel of Time turns, and Ages come and pass. In a village at the edge of the world, young Rand al'Thor is about to be pulled into a destiny he never wanted—by a mysterious visitor, shadowy riders, and a power that has not been seen in an age. The opening volume of the sprawling fifteen-book Wheel of Time, a cornerstone of modern fantasy.
books.whyReadEn: The hero's journey pushed to its limits—the cornerstone of modern epic fantasy. Immense, intricate, and utterly absorbing. Now a hit television series.

books.title: Titus Groan
books.author: Mervyn Peake
books.authorJa: マーヴィン・ピーク
books.descriptionJa: 崩れゆく巨大な城ゴーメンガースト。その継承者として生まれたタイタス。ゴシック幻想文学の最高峰として、後のファンタジーに決定的な影響を与えた。
books.whyReadJa: 「不気味な城」をめぐる、ゴシック幻想の傑作。
books.selectionReasonJa: 不気味な城をめぐる、ゴシック幻想の最高峰。
books.descriptionEn: Gormenghast, a vast and crumbling castle of endless rituals and decay, is the entire world for those who live within it. Into this labyrinth is born Titus, heir to an ancient line—and with him, change. A towering work of gothic fantasy, Peake's novel cast a decisive shadow over everything that followed it.
books.whyReadEn: A gothic fantasy masterpiece about a monstrous, decaying castle. Peake's language is like nothing else in the genre—and his influence is everywhere. Dark, strange, unforgettable.

books.title: Norse Mythology
books.author: Neil Gaiman
books.authorJa: ニール・ゲイマン
books.descriptionJa: オーディン、トール、ロキ。北欧神話の物語を、ゲイマンが現代の語り口で再話する。神々の生と死、ラグナロクまでの物語。
books.whyReadJa: 「神話」を面白く読む最高の入門。ゲイマンの語りの力。
books.selectionReasonJa: 北欧神話をゲイマンが再話した、神話入門の最高傑作。
books.descriptionEn: Neil Gaiman retells the great tales of Norse mythology—of Odin, Thor, and Loki—in his own unmistakable voice, from the creation of the worlds to the coming of Ragnarok. Playful, vivid, and deeply felt, it brings the old gods to life for modern readers while honoring the original sagas. The best possible introduction to Norse myth.
books.whyReadEn: The finest introduction to mythology—it reads like the best story you've ever been told. Gaiman's storytelling at its most effortless. Odin, Thor, Loki, and the end of all things.

books.title: 日本沈没
books.author: Komatsu Sakyo
books.authorJa: 小松左京
books.descriptionJa: 日本列島が数年のうちに沈没する——政府の極秘計画と、そこに翻弄される人々。日本SFの金字塔にして、出版当時400万部を超えるベストセラー。映画化も繰り返された、ディザスターSFの古典。
books.whyReadJa: 日本発の世界的SF。災害と国家を描く先駆けとして、世界のディザスター文学に影響を与えた。
books.selectionReasonJa: 日本SFの金字塔。世界に先駆けたディザスター文学の代表作。
books.descriptionEn: The Japanese archipelago is sinking—within years, not centuries. A secret government project races to understand the disaster and save a nation's people, while ordinary citizens are caught in the turmoil. A landmark of Japanese science fiction and a bestseller that sold over four million copies, repeatedly adapted into film, and a classic of disaster fiction.
books.whyReadEn: Japan's great contribution to world science fiction. As a pioneering story of catastrophe and nation, it influenced disaster literature everywhere—and it still hits hard today.

books.title: 北京折叠
books.author: Hao Jingfang
books.authorJa: 郝景芳
books.descriptionJa: 未来の北京。都市は三つの空間に折りたたまれ、24時間ごとに交代する。富裕層の住む第一空間、中産階級の第二空間、労働者の第三空間。ヒューゴー賞受賞の、格差を描く中国SF。
books.whyReadJa: アジア人女性初のヒューゴー賞受賞。SFで現代中国の格差を問う、注目の中国SF。
books.selectionReasonJa: ヒューゴー賞受賞。中国の格差をSFで描き、世界のSFシーンを変えた。
books.descriptionEn: In a future Beijing, the city folds into three layers that rotate every twenty-four hours: First Space for the wealthy, Second Space for the middle class, and Third Space, where the workers live underground. When a Third Space dweller crosses the boundary to save his daughter, the machinery of inequality is exposed. Hugo Award-winning Chinese science fiction about class and division.
books.whyReadEn: The first Hugo Award won by an Asian woman. Science fiction confronting inequality in contemporary China—a sharp, moving, and essential read. A novella that speaks to every divided city.

books.title: 時をかける少女
books.titleEn: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
books.author: Tsutsui Yasutaka
books.authorJa: 筒井康隆
books.descriptionJa: SF小説の父、筒井康隆の代表作。家に突然かかってくる未来からの電話。「未来から来た自分」との対話を通して、時間と記憶をめぐる物語が展開する。映画・アニメーション化もされ、日本のSF・幻想文学を代表する名作。
books.whyReadJa: 日本のSFの巨匠筒井康隆の代表作。時間をめぐる物語として、世界のSFにも通じる普遍性を持つ。
books.selectionReasonJa: 筒井康隆の代表作。日本のSF・幻想文学を代表する名作で、繰り返し映像化された。
books.descriptionEn: A classic from Tsutsui Yasutaka, a master of Japanese science fiction. A phone call from the future suddenly rings in an ordinary home, and through a dialogue with a version of herself who has traveled through time, the nature of time and memory unfolds. Adapted into film and anime, it is a beloved representative of Japanese SF and fantastic literature.
books.whyReadEn: The representative work of Tsutsui Yasutaka, one of Japan's great SF masters. A story about time with universal resonance that echoes beyond Japanese literature.
